#### **Vung Ang 2 Thermal Power Plant (1,320 MW, USC, Coal)**
- **Key Facts:** Inaugurated April 2026, developed under a BOT contract by Mitsubishi (60%) and KEPCO (40%). Uses ultra-supercritical technology for efficiency and lower emissions.
- **Significance:** First USC coal plant in Vietnam, supplying ~3% of national demand. Faces scrutiny under JETP for coal phase-out by 2050

## **5. Annotated Bibliography**

### **Primary Sources**
1. **Global Energy Monitor (GEM) Trackers**
   - [Global Coal Plant Tracker](https://globalenergymonitor.org/projects/global-coal-plant-tracker) (January 2026)
   - [Global Oil and Gas Plant Tracker](https://globalenergymonitor.org/projects/global-oil-gas-plant-tracker) (January 2026)
   - **Annotation:** Comprehensive, unit-level data on thermal power plants (>30 MWe) in Vietnam, including status, capacity, and ownership. Primary source for operational and under-construction plants.

2. **Vietnam Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT)**
   - [PDP8 Implementation Plan (Decision 768/QD-TTg)](https://www.wfw.com/articles/vietnam-issues-implementation-plan-of-power-development-plan-8/) (April 2025)
   - **Annotation:** Official list of approved, planned, and cancelled thermal power projects, including fuel type, capacity, and COD. Primary source for policy and project status.

3. **Vietnam Electricity (EVN)**
   - [EVN Annual Report 2025](https://en.evn.com.vn/d6/news/Overview-of-national-power-sources-in-2023-66-142-4147.aspx)
   - **Annotation:** Operational data, capacity, and status of EVN-owned thermal plants. Primary source for coal and gas plants.

### **Secondary Sources**
4. **Watson Farley & Williams**
   - [Vietnam issues Implementation Plan of Power Development Plan 8](https://www.wfw.com/articles/vietnam-issues-implementation-plan-of-power-development-plan-8/) (April 2024)
   - **Annotation:** Summary of PDP8’s thermal power targets (coal, LNG, domestic gas) and policy framework.

5. **Vietnam News**
   - [Unit 1 of Quang Trach 1 Thermal Power Plant connected to national grid](https://en.vietnamplus.vn/unit-1-of-quang-trach-1-thermal-power-plant-connected-to-national-grid-post340980.vnp) (April 2026)
   - **Annotation:** Confirms COD for Quang Trach 1 Unit 1 and project status.

6. **The Investor**
   - [Northern Vietnam city proposes LNG terminal project](https://theinvestor.vn/northern-vietnam-city-proposes-lng-terminal-project-d18029.html) (January 2026)
   - **Annotation:** Details on Hai Phong LNG Power Plant, including ownership and construction timeline.

7. **Nikkei Asia**
   - [Mitsubishi brings Vietnam coal plant online](https://asia.nikkei.com/business/energy/mitsubishi-brings-vietnam-coal-plant-online-with-asia-only-fuel-chain) (April 2026)
   - **Annotation:** Confirms Vung Ang 2’s commercial operation and fuel sourcing.
